leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reusable notification component with customizable content and styling
Initialize and manage a notification state array to track active messages
Implement functions to add and remove notifications from the state manager
Configure a toast display system that renders notifications based on state
Apply auto-dismissal logic to remove notifications after a specified duration
Integrate user interaction controls to manually dismiss notifications
Manipulate notification positioning and styling through component props
lessonTitle: Build reusable notification and toast manager
